REQUEST
Expand this brief into one ready-to-paste text-to-image prompt of at most 55 words: `A rust-red rowboat tied to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn.` Return only the prompt. Do not add people, buildings, other boats, animals, or active weather.

OUTPUT A
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint is tied by rope to a weathered wooden dock on a still lake before dawn. Cool blue light reveals rough dock planks and the boat’s worn edges. Mirrorlike water reflects both beneath a pale horizon, with the dock leading diagonally into the quiet composition.

OUTPUT B
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint is tied by coarse rope to a weathered wooden dock on a glassy lake before dawn. Low, wide framing follows the dock’s silver-gray planks toward the boat, its crisp reflection mirrored in dark water beneath a pale blue horizon. Photorealistic textures, subdued light, minimalist composition.

CRITERION C08-PRESERVE (hard)
The expansion preserves every supplied scene fact and adds no forbidden subject, prop, or active weather.
